items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: He made trips with me, a couple of trips with me to Chicago, and out to the Stacks.

ctx.x: Yeah, but I know there's more than one Eddie Johnson.
Well yeah, they had the little Eddie, the bright one, he used to play saxophone too, some
time back. Were there any other New Orleans guys up there other than Louie?
